headline: God of War Laufey February 16
title: God of War Laufey Release Date February 16 | PS5 Only | Gaming News
video_script: God of War Laufey has a release date. It launches on PlayStation 5 on February sixteenth, twenty twenty seven, from Santa Monica Studio. You play as Faye, also called Laufey, who wakes up in a strange land after her death. A disc edition is confirmed. Are you ready for Faye's story? Comment below!
description: God of War Laufey (Santa Monica Studio / Sony Interactive Entertainment) launches February 16, 2027 on PS5. Announced July 24, 2026. Sources: Gematsu, Engadget, The Sixth Axis.
